edges.reason: msg.sender is the staker identity and the source of the transferFrom in stake_token.
msg.sender becomes the actor whose pool and rewards are read in withdraw_earnings.
block.timestamp is written into start_time and unlock_time, creating a time based lock.
block.timestamp gates the withdrawal through the unlock_time requirement.
block.timestamp gates unstaking through the unlock_time requirement.
block.timestamp drives the elapsed-time reward computation.
staker mapping is written when a new pool is created in stake_token.
staker mapping is read and updated in withdraw_earnings.
staker mapping is read, zeroed and closed in unstake.
staker mapping is read to obtain quantity, period and withdrawals.
stakable mapping is read and its balances updated in stake_token.
stakable mapping is read to decide mint vs transfer of rewards.
stakable mapping is configured by ADMIN_configure_token_stake.
stakable balance and reward rates feed the reward computation.
staker mapping is read in get_single_pool.
is_auth is written by the onlyAuth guarded setter.
is_auth lets an authorised actor bypass the unlock_time requirement.
is_auth lets an authorised actor bypass the lock in unstake.
owner is assigned from msg.sender during construction.
locked flag guards withdraw_earnings via the safe modifier.
locked flag guards unstake via the safe modifier.
locked flag guards stake_token via the safe modifier.
router is queried for WETH when locating pairs in get_apy.
factory_address builds the IUniswapV2Factory used in get_apy.
router_address instantiates the router in the constructor.
constructor derives factory_address from router.factory().
constructor writes the authorised addresses into is_auth.
withdraw_earnings calls get_reward_on_pool to obtain rewards.
unstake calls withdraw_earnings, nesting external calls before principal is returned.
stake_token executes the external transferFrom operation.
withdraw_earnings executes an external mint_rewards call.
withdraw_earnings executes an external reward token transfer.
unstake executes an external principal transfer before state zeroing.
withdraw_earnings updates total_earned and total_withdraw after the external calls.
The mint_rewards external call to an arbitrary token can re-enter withdraw_earnings.
The reward token transfer can re-enter withdraw_earnings before accounting is updated.
The ERC20 transferFrom can re-enter stake_token while pool state is inconsistent.
The principal transfer can re-enter unstake before the pool is zeroed.
get_reward_on_pool performs the chained multiply and divide reward formula.
The raw arithmetic result is returned as the pool reward.
getTokenPrice performs the external pair and token calls.
Pair and token contracts are attacker controlled and could execute code during pricing.
get_apy calls getTokenPrice twice for staked and reward token prices.
unstake zeroes quantity, deactivates the pool and pushes to closed_pools.
stake_token records the new pool entry in the staker mapping.
stake_token updates stakable balance, locked and unlocked counters.
token parameter determines which stakable farm and ERC20 is used in stake_token.
amount parameter is transferred in and recorded as the pool quantity.
timelock parameter sets unlock_time, time_period and locked balance bucket.
pool parameter selects the staker pool whose earnings are withdrawn.
pool parameter selects the staker pool being unstaked.
actor parameter selects whose stake is used in the reward computation.
pool parameter selects the stake entry used in the reward computation.
yearly flag switches between a full year and the elapsed time branch.
token parameter selects which stakable entry the admin toggles.
_stakable flag is written into the stakable enabled field.
token parameter selects the farm configuration being written.
unlocked_reward parameter sets the default reward rate used by reward maths.
token_given parameter sets the reward token that withdraw_earnings pays out.
times_allowed array controls the loop and the allowed lock periods.
times_reward array supplies the timed reward rates written to stakable.
addy parameter is the address granted or revoked authorisation.
booly parameter is the authorisation value written to is_auth.
authorized array drives the constructor loop that seeds is_auth.
actor parameter selects the staker whose pool is read.
pool parameter selects the individual stake entry read.
The local ERC20 instance is the receiver of the external transferFrom call.
pool_id local aliases last_id and keys the newly written stake entry.
actor local is initialised from msg.sender in withdraw_earnings.
local_token_staked drives the mintable branch selection.
local_token_rewarded is cast to ERC20 for the external reward transfer.
rewards local is the amount passed to the external reward payout.
already_given local receives the second return value of get_reward_on_pool.
token local is the ERC20 used for the external principal transfer in unstake.
local_pool_amount is the staked quantity used in the reward formula.
local_time_period indexes the timed reward rate mapping.
local_token_staked indexes the stakable mapping for pool totals.
local_time_passed derives from block.timestamp and scales the reward.
local_total_pool is the divisor of the chained reward arithmetic.
local_reward_timed is the rate fed into the multiplication chain.
local_reward is the intermediate result of the vulnerable arithmetic.
local_reward_adjusted subtracts prior withdrawals and can underflow logically.
factory local is used to look up the token pairs in get_apy.
staked_price feeds the multiplication computing staked value.
rewarded_price feeds the multiplication computing rewarded value.
apy local is produced by dividing rewarded_value by staked_value.
init local is the constructor loop counter over the authorised list.

normalization_plan.reason: The token parameter is only meaningful through stake_token's farm selection and ERC20 calls.
The amount parameter is consumed entirely by stake_token's transfer and pool accounting.
The timelock parameter only exists to configure the pool entry created by stake_token.
The pool parameter indexes the stake entry handled by withdraw_earnings.
The pool parameter indexes the stake entry handled by unstake.
The actor parameter is used solely inside get_reward_on_pool lookups.
The pool parameter is used solely inside get_reward_on_pool lookups.
The yearly flag only selects a branch inside get_reward_on_pool.
The token parameter is only used to index stakable in ADMIN_set_token_state.
The _stakable flag is written directly by ADMIN_set_token_state.
The token parameter only indexes the farm configuration in ADMIN_configure_token_stake.
unlocked_reward is stored by ADMIN_configure_token_stake.
token_given becomes the reward token stored by ADMIN_configure_token_stake.
times_allowed only drives the configuration loop of ADMIN_configure_token_stake.
times_reward only supplies values stored by ADMIN_configure_token_stake.
The addy parameter is only assigned into is_auth by ADMIN_set_auth.
The booly parameter is only assigned into is_auth by ADMIN_set_auth.
The authorized array is only iterated by the constructor to seed is_auth.
The actor parameter is only used to read the staker mapping in get_single_pool.
The pool parameter is only used to read the stake entry in get_single_pool.
The local ERC20 instance exists only as the target of the external transferFrom.
pool_id is a temporary alias for last_id inside stake_token.
actor is a temporary copy of msg.sender inside withdraw_earnings.
local_token_staked is a temporary cache used by withdraw_earnings branching.
local_token_rewarded is cast solely for the external reward transfer.
rewards is the amount passed to the external reward payout.
already_given is a temporary holder for a get_reward_on_pool return value.
The token local exists solely as the ERC20 used for the external principal transfer.
local_pool_amount is a temporary copy of the staked quantity.
local_time_period is a temporary copy of the pool timelock.
local_token_staked is a temporary index used inside get_reward_on_pool.
local_time_passed is a temporary elapsed-time value in get_reward_on_pool.
local_total_pool is the divisor of the vulnerable reward arithmetic.
local_reward_timed is a temporary reward rate in get_reward_on_pool.
local_reward is the intermediate product of the unsafe arithmetic.
local_reward_adjusted is the final local value returned to callers.
The factory local exists only for the pair lookups inside get_apy.
staked_price is a temporary price input for the APY computation.
rewarded_price is a temporary price input for the APY computation.
apy is the temporary result returned by get_apy.
init is the loop counter of the constructor's authorisation loop.
